one_liner: Attio CRM has a broad public REST API with self-serve OAuth 2.0 and API keys, free-plan API access, webhooks, an OpenAPI spec and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow (PKCE supported) with apps registered self-serve at build.attio.com. Workspace API keys (Bearer) for single-workspace use. HTTP Basic with the token as username is also accepted. Unpublished apps can only grant tokens to workspaces they're shared with.
access_notes: Free plan includes full REST API and webhooks, with no approval gate. Installing an app requires a workspace admin.
blocker_notes: No meaningful blocker. Free workspace gives API access and OAuth app registration is self-serve.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to generate an access token: 1. By implementing an OAuth 2.0 flow 2. By generating an API key for your workspace
In the developer console, select **New app** in the sidebar.
We also support HTTP Basic Authentication, where the username is the token and the password is left blank
There is no separate developer signup, no approval gate, and no enterprise-only restriction.
API and webhook access, App SDK, MCP server and workflows included; no credit card
an endpoint catalogue spanning custom objects, records, lists, notes, tasks, files, meetings, and call recordings
an OpenAPI spec is downloadable, and API access ships on every plan, including free.
Attio MCP is Attio's hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace.
